protocol.demand_sampling: each seed keeps a deterministic random subset (fraction above) of the calibrated hourly demand, identical in all three arms; SUMO --scale 1
protocol.od_population: every kept vehicle keeps its calibrated O/D, departure time and static route
protocol.routing_horizon: one routing round = 900 s of departures; the oracle table for a round is the measured edge travel time of the paired baseline over that round
protocol.equipped_rule: pipeline/routing/predictive_routing.equipped(vid, compliance): deterministic hash of the vehicle id
protocol.coverage_mode: oracle: MEASURED per-edge travel time (sampledSeconds-weighted over the round), unmeasured edges free flow; no DERIVED propagation

admission._rule: thin TrafficTwin layer above SUMO routing: a vehicle is admitted to an alternative only if no edge of it would exceed max_edge_load_ratio after admission, and no more than max_share_per_alternative of the vehicles in the round are sent to the same alternative; a vehicle rerouted within reroute_cooldown_s is not advised again
admission._share_gate_min: the share gate only applies to rounds of at least share_gate_min_vehicles vehicles: a single analysed trip is not a herd

candidates._generator: duarouter (pinned eclipse-sumo v1_27_1) on the forecast weight file: run 0 exact weights; runs 1..K-1 with --weights.random-factor and distinct seeds (SUMO's documented route-diversification mechanism, Simulation/Routing.md 'Randomized travel times'); distinct edge sequences kept; the vehicle's current route is always candidate 0

load_penalty._rule: BPR volume-delay on the vehicles this optimizer has already admitted: load_penalty_s = sum_over_edges future_tt_e x alpha x (admitted_e / capacity_e)^beta; capacity_e = lanes x capacity_veh_per_lane_h x window_h
load_penalty._source: Bureau of Public Roads volume-delay function, standard alpha=0.15 beta=4; 1800 veh/h/lane is the HCM saturation-flow order of magnitude

overlap_penalty._rule: overlap_penalty_s = switch_cost_s x (1 - shared_length_fraction_with_current_route); the current route itself costs 0

probe.note: one user trip, reported separately, never the system conclusion

protocol.primary_metric: total vehicle-hours of every vehicle loaded before the horizon: inserted vehicles to arrival or the horizon, never-inserted vehicles from their departure to the horizon
